answer: Agents trading onyx shipments at a wharf use escrowed stake to weight votes on which freight offers appear first. Each unit of stake counts once across all accounts, and withdrawals require a 30-day wait. Splitting a deposit among a thousand identities adds no voting power, so the market offers no haven for cheap sybils: an attacker must buy and lock enough stake to outweigh honest agents, tying up capital for the entire attack.
